title: Visiting Analytics Engineer
description:
Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.
We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $15M ARR, with a 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our new New York office.
 About the Role
 We're building the data foundation that powers how Peec AI understands its business, customers, and products.
 As we scale, we're bringing data from business systems across Finance, Sales and Growth, into one reliable analytics platform, making trusted data accessible to everyone, including Product and Engineering
 We're looking for an Analytics Engineer Intern who loves solving problems, building things, and turning raw data into something useful.
 You’ll drive speed and AI-adoption in the business teams, by building an AI-first analytics platform that brings data together in a governed warehouse and lets teams explore it through a conversational analytics tool, then create dashboards and apps from the results.
 You'll build from day one. Your work will go into production, help teams make better decisions, and directly contribute to Peec's growth. You'll help make data and insights accessible to business leaders, and steer commercial decision making, at scale.
 What You'll Do
 Build our data foundation: Integrate product, billing, CRM, and business data into data warehouse to create a reliable source of truth
 Develop analytics models: Write SQL and dbt models to transform raw data into clean, reusable datasets

title: Azure Data Engineer with Databricks & PySpark
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Azure Data Engineer with Databricks & PySpark based in Netherlands.
 We are seeking an experienced Azure Data Engineer to design and deliver scalable, reliable data integration solutions in a fully remote European environment.
You will build and optimise modern ETL/ELT pipelines, transforming data from multiple sources into enterprise data warehouses.
Working extensively with Azure Databricks, PySpark, SQL and Delta Lake, you will contribute to robust, high-performing data platforms.
The role combines hands-on engineering, data modelling, automation and production support.
You will collaborate with data analysts, reporting specialists and software developers to translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
This is an opportunity to apply modern cloud data engineering practices, improve data quality and contribute to the evolution of enterprise data solutions.
 Accountabilities
 Design, develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that extract, transform and load data from multiple sources into enterprise data warehouses.
 Build, optimise and maintain data processing workflows using Azure Databricks, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake and Databricks Workflows.
 Develop and manage data pipelines using Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, formerly Delta Live Tables, and organise data assets through Unity Catalog.
 Design and optimise SQL queries, data transformations and dimensional data models to improve processing efficiency and data accessibility.
 Integrate data from APIs, files and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, working with formats such as Delta, Parquet and JSON.
 Implement automated testing and quality assurance processes, debug issues and troubleshoot production pipelines to ensure data accuracy and reliability.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
 Discord is looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team and help build the trusted data foundations that power decisions across the company. Data Engineering is the foundational layer between Discord's raw data and the teams that depend on it: Data Science, ML, Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders. You'll design, build, and maintain clean, tested, well-documented datasets that those teams can discover, trust, and self-serve from.
 You'll join one of two squads, Gaming or Ads , working alongside experienced data engineers and data scientists. This is a growth role: you'll take on well-scoped problems with guidance from senior teammates, and build toward owning a data domain end to end.
 If you enjoy data modeling, SQL, and making reliable data easy for other teams to use, read on.

 Build and maintain well-modeled, tested, and documented datasets in BigQuery using dbt, with guidance from senior data engineers
 Take ownership of scoped pipelines, tables, and metric improvements within your squad, from requirements through delivery and documentation
 Write accurate, efficient SQL and Python to transform structured and unstructured data into curated datasets for analytics, experimentation, and ML
 Improve the reliability, freshness, and quality of existing datasets by adding tests, monitoring, and documentation

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description:
The Challenge
 Talk360 connects more than 6 million people worldwide every year, and we rely on data we can trust. We have built the foundations of a modern data platform, and now we are looking for a Staff level Analytics Engineer to carry the build forward and make that data work for every team.
 You will be a driving force in how Talk360 works with data, spotting where the numbers disagree, helping decide what the right definition is, and building the models that settle it. As the foundations mature, the role might lean further towards analytics. This is something we will shape together.
 Our current data platform includes:
 Ingestion: Stitch
 Data warehouse: BigQuery
 Transformation: dbt Cloud
 Visualisation: Omni, replacing Tableau and QuickSight
What you’ll do
 Data Modelling & Pipelines: Build and maintain scalable, reliable data models that expose high-quality data for analysis and reporting. Decide what each new data source needs and model it for the warehouse, working with Tech, who own our infrastructure and ingestion.
 Source of Truth: Grow our dbt project with new, tested and documented models, keeping one agreed definition for every metric. You will be extending and improving a codebase with its own conventions, not starting from a blank page.
 Automation: Replace manual routines and hand-built reports with reliable, automatic reporting that teams can check and trust.
 Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with teams across the business to understand what they need, challenge it where it helps, and translate it into technical solutions that enable reliable self-serve data for decision making.
 Quality & Governance: Set the standards and conventions that keep the warehouse maintainable as we grow, and build the monitoring and alerting that catches data quality issues before they reach the business.

title: Senior Data Engineer, Cloudforce One
description:
About Us
 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
 Available Locations: London, UK
 About the role
 Cloudforce One is Cloudflare’s threat operations and research team, responsible for identifying and disrupting cyber threats ranging from sophisticated cyber criminal activity to nation-state sponsored advanced persistent threats (APTs).
